units.source_text: 夏尽秋来，凉风忽起。

en.t: Summer ended and autumn arrived, and a cool wind suddenly rose.

units.source_text: 源氏想起了古歌“吹起我夫衣……”之句，

en.t: Genji remembered the line from an old poem, "Blow upon my husband's robe...",

units.source_text: 颇有萧条冷落之感，难于忍受，

en.t: and a deep feeling of desolation and loneliness came over him, almost too hard to bear,

units.source_text: 便频频地前往探望玉鬘，镇日住在那里，

en.t: so he went again and again to visit Tamakazura, spending whole days there,

units.source_text: 有时指导她弹琴。

en.t: and sometimes taught her how to play the koto.

units.source_text: 初五六日的月亮很早就已西沉。

en.t: The moon of the fifth or sixth night had already set early in the west.

units.source_text: 略微显得阴暗的天空、风吹荻花的声音，

en.t: The slightly darkened sky and the sound of the wind blowing through the reed blossoms

units.source_text: 都渐渐地含有秋意了。

en.t: were both gradually taking on the feeling of autumn.

units.source_text: 源氏与玉鬘二人以琴作枕而并卧。

en.t: Genji and Tamakazura lay side by side, using the koto as a pillow.

units.source_text: 他心中时时叹息又自问：

en.t: In his heart he sighed from time to time and asked himself:

units.source_text: “如此纯洁的并卧，世间哪有其例？”

en.t: "Where in the world is there another example of lying together so innocently?"

units.source_text: 过分夜深，生怕惹人疑议，

en.t: Since the night had grown very late, he feared that people might become suspicious,

units.source_text: 便起身准备回去。

en.t: so he rose and prepared to return.

units.source_text: 庭前有几处篝火已经熄灭，

en.t: Several of the bonfires before the garden had already gone out,

units.source_text: 源氏就召唤随从的右近大夫，叫他点火。

en.t: so Genji summoned his attendant Ukon no Taifu and told him to light them again.

units.source_text: 凉气四溢的湖边，

en.t: Beside the pond, where cool air spread all around,

units.source_text: 亭亭如盖的卫矛树底下，

en.t: beneath a tall spindle tree shaped like a canopy,

units.source_text: 疏疏朗朗地点着松明，离开窗前稍远，室内不受热气。

en.t: the torches were lit sparsely and brightly, set a little away from the window so that the heat did not enter the room.

units.source_text: 那火光显得很凉爽，

en.t: The firelight looked strangely cool,

units.source_text: 照在玉鬘身上，姿态异常艳丽。

en.t: and as it shone on Tamakazura, her figure appeared extraordinarily lovely.

units.source_text: 源氏摸摸她的头发，

en.t: Genji touched her hair,

units.source_text: 觉得滑润如玉，雅洁无比。

en.t: and found it smooth and lustrous as jade, refined and pure beyond compare.

units.source_text: 温恭淑慎的姿态实在可爱，

en.t: Her gentle, modest, and careful manner was truly endearing,

units.source_text: 逗得他不肯回去了。

en.t: and it made him unwilling to leave.

units.source_text: 假意说道：

en.t: Feigning casualness, he said:

units.source_text: “应该不断地有人在这里点火才是。

en.t: "There really ought to be someone here keeping the fires lit all the time.

units.source_text: 夏天没有月亮的晚上，

en.t: On summer nights when there is no moon,

units.source_text: 庭中没有火光，教人觉得害怕，而且寂寞无聊。”

en.t: if there is no firelight in the garden, it feels frightening, and also lonely and dull."

units.source_text: 便赋诗赠玉鬘：

en.t: Then he composed a poem and presented it to Tamakazura:
